blocks.text: This October, Robinsons Department Store is refreshing the modern male wardrobe with the launch of Men’s Fair 2026, bringing together street-smart staples, elevated essentials, and high-performance activewear for every lifestyle. Running from October 1 to 31, 2026, the campaign brings together top local and international fashion, footwear, activewear, and grooming brands, offering exclusive savings of up to 60% off across a wide selection of men’s apparel, accessories, shoes, bags, sports, and beauty items. Whether upgrading workwear classics, building a versatile weekend wardrobe, or hunting for daily essentials, shoppers can look forward to top fashion, footwear, and innerwear brands, including Jag, Lee, […]...
